panel.purpose: Every panel and tile, composers, search at rest, the past on the day line, plain time pills, nav hover.

panel-2.purpose: Active nav pill, tile hover, segmented track, ghost/icon hover, zero-spend bars, skeletons.

card.purpose: Row cards, insets, inputs, calendar cells, note previews, quick-note popover.

card-line.purpose: 1px card border and the few hairline separators.

card-line-2.purpose: Card hover border, input and secondary button borders, empty check ring, dashed empty states.

ink.purpose: Primary text; the Quick note button ground.

ink-2.purpose: Secondary text, sub lines, labels, nav at rest.

accent.purpose: The only acting hue: primary buttons, checked tasks, today, selection, the now marker, ordinary spend bars, focus.

accent-ink.purpose: Text and tick on solid teal.

accent-soft.purpose: Day-line event pills, next-up time pill, sidebar count, focus ring, selection, search highlight.

accent-line.purpose: Inset edge of day-line event pills.

red.purpose: Overdue and at-or-over-threshold data; errors and destructive actions in chrome.

red-soft.purpose: Ground for overdue pills and chips, error callout, invalid ring, danger hover.

toast.purpose: Inverted toast ground (light in dark mode).

auth-title.purpose: Login and sign-up titles; auth preview greeting at 38px.

figure.purpose: Tile values and spend totals; 28px on phones, 26px calendar month total. Always weight 400.

panel-title.purpose: Panel heads and the quick-note head.

body.purpose: Default text, buttons, inputs, nav. Notes at 15px/1.55.

label.purpose: Tile labels, group heads (600), field labels, sub lines (400), panel meta and links.

caption.purpose: Time pills, legends, hints, note footers.

axis.purpose: Day-line hours, bar axis, calendar overflow (11.5-12px).

shadows.name: float
shadows.purpose: Floating layers only: Quick note button, quick-note popover, toasts, mobile sheet.

shadows.name: focus-ring
shadows.purpose: Input and composer focus, with an accent border. Invalid swaps to var(--red-soft) and a red border.

shadows.name: event-edge
shadows.purpose: Edge of day-line event pills and the legend swatch.

shadows.name: selected-ring
shadows.purpose: Selected calendar day, with an accent border.

shadows.name: segment-ring
shadows.purpose: Selected segment in a segmented control.

shadows.name: today-bar
shadows.purpose: Today's bar in the spend chart.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Presses, check fill, settle, popover, toasts.

motion.name: hover
motion.purpose: Colour, background and border hovers; always inside @media (hover: hover).

motion.name: press-check
motion.purpose: Task check; tick scales 0.6 to 1 over 200ms when checked.

motion.name: popover
motion.value: scale(0.96) translateY(6px) to rest; opacity 180ms, transform 200ms ease-out; close 140/160ms ease
motion.purpose: Quick-note popover, transform-origin: bottom right (from its button).

motion.name: toast
motion.value: enter from translateY(12px) scale(0.98): opacity 200ms, transform 240ms ease-out; leave 150ms

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: prefers-reduced-motion: reduce -> all animation and transition durations 0.01ms

breakpoints.name: md
breakpoints.purpose: Padding to 28px; Today side stack drops below as a two-up split.

breakpoints.name: sm
breakpoints.purpose: Sidebar becomes a slide-in sheet behind a 52px top bar; grid to one column, tiles two-up; auth preview hidden.

breakpoints.name: xs
breakpoints.purpose: Panels 16px padding/20px radius; controls full width; calendar cells 54px with dots; Quick note becomes a 52px circle.

narrative.northStar: A Calm Home for One Day
narrative.overview:
Syncrona is a personal planner that reads like a quiet room rather than an office. A white page holds soft stone panels one step off white; inside the panels sit white row cards, each one a real thing you can tick, add or read. The page opens with a serif greeting and one sentence of fact about the day ("1 task overdue, and Finish portfolio case study draft at 17:00"), then four count tiles, then the Today panel with the day line, its signature. Every other screen (tasks, calendar, expenses, notes, settings) is built from the same panels and rows, so the product feels like one place.

Depth is tonal, not cast. Three grounds (page, panel, card) do all the layering, and nothing at rest carries a shadow. Colour is nearly absent: a cool grey-green neutral family and one deep teal that marks every action, every selection and the day's own data. Red appears only when something is late or over the limit, or when something has gone wrong. Density is comfortable desktop-app density (14px body, 56px rows, 16px gutters) in the Linear, Things and Raycast register, with Instrument Sans throughout and Instrument Serif for a single line of greeting.

The world refuses the spreadsheet. Lists are stacks of separate row cards with 6px between them, never ruled tables; the calendar is a grid of separate cards, never a ruled month; numbers are tabular figures inside rows, never columns of cells.
keyCharacteristics: White page, stone panels, white row cards: three grounds, no shadows at rest.
Deep teal is the only hue that acts or marks today's data; red only for late, over-limit and error.
Instrument Sans for everything; Instrument Serif for the greeting and auth titles alone.
Three radii: 22px panels, 12px row cards, full pills on controls.
Centred 1100px column on a 12-column, 16px-gap grid beside a 240px labelled sidebar.
The day line: 06:00 to midnight, teal event pills, task rings, a live now marker and the day's spend at its end.
Motion is press-scale and a quick settle; nothing performs an entrance.

rules.name: The One Teal Rule
rules.body: Teal is the only chromatic hue on the page. If it is teal, it can be pressed, it is selected, or it is today's data. Never use it as decoration, never introduce a second accent.

rules.name: The Red Means Late Rule
rules.body: In data, red marks exactly two things: a task past its due day, and a payment at or over the user's threshold. Nothing else in the data is red; in chrome, red is reserved for errors and destructive actions.

rules.name: The Three Grounds Rule
rules.body: Depth is the step from white page to stone panel to white card. A new surface takes one of those three grounds; it does not invent a fourth tint.

rules.name: The One Line of Serif Rule
rules.body: Instrument Serif sets the greeting on Today and the titles on login and sign-up, nothing else. No serif panel titles, no serif numbers.

rules.name: The Tabular Figures Rule
rules.body: Every time, amount, count and date is set with tabular numerals so columns of rows align without becoming a table.

rules.name: The Centred Column Rule
rules.body: Content never runs edge to edge on desktop; it sits in the 1100px column, and every panel snaps to the 12-column grid.

rules.name: The Only Floating Things Lift Rule
rules.body: If it scrolls with the page, it has no shadow. A shadow means the thing is above the page and can be dismissed.

rules.name: The Three Radii Rule
rules.body: Panel 22, card 12, control pill. A new component picks one by what it is, not by how big it is.

rules.name: The Press and Settle Rule
rules.body: Motion answers the user's own action: a press scales, a check fills, a new row settles. Nothing performs an entrance on page load.

dos: **Do** build every new screen from the same three grounds: white page, stone panel (22px), white row cards (12px) inside it.
**Do** use teal for the one primary action per area, for selection, and for today's data; keep everything else neutral.
**Do** use red only for overdue tasks, payments at or over the threshold, errors and destructive actions.
**Do** show lists as row cards with a lead, a title, a sub line and an end slot, 6px apart, with actions revealed on hover.
**Do** set times, amounts, counts and dates in tabular figures, with amounts in rupees (₹).
**Do** keep controls as full pills (buttons 38px, segments 30px, time pills 24px).
**Do** gate hover styles behind `(hover: hover)`, give presses a 0.97 scale on the ease-out curve, and respect reduced motion.
**Do** design empty, loading (skeleton rows) and error (callout with Try again) states for every list.
donts: **Don't** put a shadow on anything that scrolls with the page; only the Quick note button, its popover, toasts and the mobile sheet lift.

**Don't** lay data out as a ruled table or spreadsheet grid; separate cards replace ruled rows and cells. Hairlines are kept for the sidebar edge, the user-row and settings separators, and the day line's three-hour ticks.
**Don't** introduce a second accent hue or use teal as decoration.
**Don't** use Instrument Serif outside the greeting and the auth titles.
**Don't** set large figures bold; tile figures and totals stay at weight 400.
**Don't** put payments on the day line's track; they have no time and live in the legend total and the rows.
